dataRepair.title: Data repair

aiSuggestions.title: Helix repair suggestions
aiSuggestions.description: Propose a typed repair plan (close, quarantine, or partial-update) for one stale charging session or drive from the inventory below. Helix never writes; review the proposal and use the matching baseline form to apply it.

dataRepair.callout: Suggestions come from durable history only: a session is listed when its stored state is contradicted by a later signal, never because it is simply old. Applying a repair rewrites the end timestamp (and, for drives, the derived duration) of that one session, is recorded in the audit log, and is never done automatically.
dataRepair.truncated: The scan hit its per-request limit, so more sessions may need repair than are listed here. Apply what is shown and refresh.

subtitle.suggestions: {{count}} session boundary(s) contradicted by later evidence
subtitle.clean: Find and repair broken drive and charging session boundaries
subtitle.workspace: Review evidence-backed anomalies, coordinate decisions, and apply reversible corrections.

diagnostics.title: Direct evidence diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Inspect durable signal contradictions and manually review incomplete sessions. These deeper scans run only while this workspace is open.

driveOpenChargingStarted.label: Drive left open, then charging started
driveOpenChargingStarted.why: The car was last seen driving, and the next durable event is a charging session starting. A car cannot drive and charge at once, so the Park signal that should have ended this drive was never recorded.

driveOpenParkObserved.label: Drive left open after the car parked
driveOpenParkObserved.why: Drive telemetry recorded the car shifting into Park after this drive started, but the drive was never closed. The signal arrived; the completion write did not.

driveEndAfterContradiction.label: Drive ends long after it really finished
driveEndAfterContradiction.why: This drive is already closed, but its end time is well after durable evidence shows the drive had finished — so it swallowed time that belongs to another session.

chargingOpenChargeEnded.label: Charging left open after it stopped
chargingOpenChargeEnded.why: A later charge-state observation shows charging had stopped, but the session is still recorded as in progress.

chargingOpenDriveStarted.label: Charging left open, then the car drove away
chargingOpenDriveStarted.why: The car shifted into a driving gear (or a drive was recorded) while this charging session was still open. Charging and driving are mutually exclusive.

chargingEndAfterContradiction.label: Charging ends long after it really finished
chargingEndAfterContradiction.why: This charging session is already closed, but its end time is well after durable evidence shows charging had finished.

unknown.label: Session boundary looks wrong
unknown.why: Stored session state contradicts later durable evidence.

blocked.overlapsNextSession: Applying this would still leave the session overlapping the next one for this vehicle. Fix the neighbouring session first.
blocked.unknown: This suggestion cannot be applied right now.

timeline.lastInSession: Last evidence the session was still running
timeline.noInSessionDetail: Nothing durable was written between the session start and the contradiction.
timeline.proposedDetail: Never later than the contradicting evidence

card.label: Repair suggestion for {{kind}} #{{id}}
card.risk: Applying rewrites only the end timestamp (and the derived duration for drives). Measured totals such as distance, energy and speed are left untouched, so they may still reflect the original window.
card.applied: Applied. Refresh to re-check the remaining suggestions.
card.manualOnly: Nothing is applied until you confirm.
card.genericError: The repair was rejected. Refresh and review again.

confirm.title: Apply this repair?
confirm.message: This rewrites {{kind}} #{{id}} to end at {{end}}. Distance, energy and speed totals are NOT recomputed — they were measured over the original window. This is recorded in the audit log and is not undone automatically.
confirm.caseImpactDescription: Review the exact server-calculated impact before applying this boundary.

manualConfirm.saveMessage: This updates the entered measurements without changing the session boundary. The correction is recorded in the audit log.
manualConfirm.closeMessage: This uses the exact end timestamp you entered. The server will reject overlaps or concurrent changes and record the boundary in the audit log.
manualConfirm.quarantineMessage: This removes {{kind}} #{{id}} from active data, but preserves a checksummed snapshot for verified restore. The reason and operator are recorded in the audit log.
manualConfirm.quarantineReasonPlaceholder: Explain why this session should be removed from active data

stale.intro: Incomplete sessions with no contradicting evidence. These are listed for manual inspection only — nothing in the recorded history establishes where they should end.

cases.workspaceDescription: Continuous detection creates durable, assignable cases. No repair is applied without operator review.
cases.queueDescription: Durable findings stay visible until an operator reviews and resolves them.
cases.refreshFailed: Repair cases could not refresh. Showing the most recently loaded queue.
cases.empty: No repair cases match these filters.
cases.drawerLoading: Loading durable evidence and operator history
cases.evidenceDescription: Durable observations used to establish the session boundary.
cases.controlledDescription: Apply a verified boundary, dismiss a false positive, or move the source session into reversible quarantine.
cases.restoreDescription: The original row and linked relationships will be verified and restored atomically.
cases.reasonRequiredDescription: Provide an operator note. This action is recorded in the audit trail.

findings.durationMismatch: Stored duration does not match the session window
findings.chargingOverlap: Charging session overlaps another charging session
findings.odometerRollback: Odometer moves backwards during the session
findings.socInconsistent: State of charge changes in the wrong direction

blockedReasons.structuralCorrection: This structural anomaly requires a manual correction
blockedReasons.operatorAction: This case records an explicit operator action
blockedReasons.notApplicable: No safe automatic boundary is available

bulk.noReviewable: Only open cases can begin review.
bulk.noDismissible: Only open or in-review cases can be dismissed.
bulk.confirmDismissDescription: Dismissal changes case metadata only. Source sessions remain untouched and the decision is audited.
bulk.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why these findings are false positives

cases.briefDescription: Server-reported repair case workload; active cases are open plus in-review cases.
cases.briefScope: Repair case statistics response; separate from the filtered queue and diagnosis scan.

quarantine.title: Quarantine ledger
quarantine.description: Every removal retains a checksummed recovery snapshot and a complete operator trail.
quarantine.refreshFailed: Quarantine records could not refresh. Showing the most recently loaded ledger.
quarantine.empty: No quarantine records match this filter.
quarantine.confirmRestoreDescription: The snapshot checksum and schema version will be verified before the session and its relationships are restored.
quarantine.restoreReasonPlaceholder: Explain why this session should be restored

preview.title: Verified impact
preview.revalidated: The server revalidated the current row, evidence, concurrency pin, and overlap guard.

field.validEndedAtRequired: Enter a valid RFC3339 end timestamp first.
